records.symptom: Engine light on, code P0171, rough idle
Code P0171 came back three days after the sensor change
records.cause: Cracked intake hose after the throttle body (vacuum leak)
records.action: Sprayed carb cleaner around intake hoses at idle — RPM jumped at the cracked hose; replaced hose; cleared code; road test
Swapped coils between cylinders — misfire moved with coil 2; replaced that coil; checked plugs

records.symptom: SUV cranks long on cold mornings, starts with white smoke
records.action: Tested glow plug resistance; replaced the two open ones; checked glow relay

tips.text: P0171 means the engine is running lean (too much air). Before buying an O2 sensor, spray carb cleaner around the intake hoses at idle — if RPM jumps, you found a vacuum leak. Saves a ₹4,000 sensor.
For a misfire, swap the ignition coil with the next cylinder and re-scan. If the misfire code moves with the coil, it's the coil. If it stays, check plug and injector.
P0420 does not always mean a dead catalytic converter. Check for exhaust leaks and compare front and rear O2 sensor readings first — a converter costs 50 times more than a gasket.
Battery drain: wait for the modules to sleep (about 20-30 minutes), then measure. More than about 50 mA is suspicious — pull fuses one by one until the current drops.
Diesel that starts hard only on cold mornings with white smoke — test glow plugs before touching the injectors.
